about_the_game:
Get ready to dive into the most absurd nuclear chaos imaginable.
In R.A.D, you and your friends play as clumsy workers in hazmat suits and oversized gloves, sent to “clean up” contaminated facilities after accidents… most of which you probably caused yourselves.

⚙️ Key Features:

🧍‍♂️ Chaotic first-person co-op: Work with (or against) your teammates as you struggle to complete objectives in the middle of total disaster.

💥 Ridiculously fun physics: Throw tools, push your friends around, or let an out-of-control turbine launch you into orbit.

🧰 Clean, repair, and survive: Decontaminate areas, fix questionably safe Soviet machinery, and scavenge valuable scrap.

☢️ Soviet satire & dark humor: A tribute to bureaucracy, forced heroism, and the “efficiency” of collective work.

🎨 Retro-cartoon aesthetic: Faded colors, rusty tech, and a style straight out of a 1970s safety manual.

Working together has never been so dangerous… or so much fun.

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains psychological horror elements, frightening imagery, and sudden jump scares that may startle players. It also includes threatening entities and dark, unsettling environments.
There is no sexual content, sexual violence, drug/alcohol use, or self-harm depicted in this game.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit version 1909 revision .1350
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4430
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960 2GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 64-bit Windows 11 (Latest Feature Update)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600K / AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2070 8GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
